summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an SEC-registered public offering of 311,876 shares of common stock at $4.008 per share, with a concurrent private placement of unregistered warrants exercisable at the same price and expiring in five years. The offering price represents a ~20% discount to the June 11, 2026 closing price of $5.01. Proceeds before expenses total ~$1.25M. The filing is an ordinary registered direct offering combined with a warrant private placement, not a special-situation event. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle; the filing is a routine capital raise.
